title: NAEP age-13 math score decline, 2020 to 2023, by performance group

source.name: NAEP Long-Term Trend Assessment, mathematics, age 13

notes: Score decline from 2020 to 2023 was uneven: the 10th percentile fell 14 points and the 25th percentile fell 12 points, both steeper than the 9-point decline for the national average.
